caption:
$0 in savings vs $1,000 in savings. 😬

Same $600 car repair.

One person pulls it from savings and moves on. The other puts it on a credit card and pays interest for months.

The emergency fund doesn't make you rich. It stops one bad day from becoming a bad year.

Which side of this are you on right now?
first_comment: Be honest: do you have $1,000 saved for emergencies? 👇
